n: Brain in a Bag (neural network unplugged)
t: A group activity where each student plays a neuron in an artificial brain.
steps: Find Brain in a Bag on the cs4fn site or on STEM Learning.
Gather props such as tubes, rope, and bags.
Check the props against the activity page. They came from search snippets.
Explain what a neuron does to the class.
Arrange students as neurons and run the activity.
Try the cs4fn web applet to see the same idea on screen.
